children: Livestock futures on the CME close lower, with volume for cutouts of either beef or pork being light, says StoneX in a note. That light volume persists in post-Labor Day trading - although through midday, the USDA reported a big jump in average pork carcass cutout prices, up $7.31 per hundredweight to $100.17 per cwt. The Goldman roll continues today, in which fund traders are seen as rolling short positions over to future months. Lean hog futures closed trading down 0.6% to 74.6 cents a pound, while live cattle futures settled down 0.4% to $2.1825 a pound. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
